item.title: From Figma to Production: The Modern Design-to-Code Pipeline in 2026 — via awesome-design-systems
Designesy — via awesome-design-systems
item.description: 40-check design-system contract verification engine. Scores any URL against DTCG 2025.10 token conformance, WCAG 2.2 AA, motion, and typography. Includes DTCG token validator, stylelint plugin, and MCP server.

item.title: Color Blindness Simulator — via awesome-design-systems
item.description: Shows how any image or built-in test scene looks with protan, deutan, or tritan vision at adjustable severity, side by side with the original. Uses the Machado (2009) model, so partial deficiencies can be simulated rather than only the complete forms.
